supersedes.reason: First registration pointed at a free-tier ngrok tunnel to a local process -- ephemeral by construction. This one points at the real Workers deployment, which stays up without anyone's laptop running. The old draft listing has no CLI delete; leaving it in the dashboard, ignore it.

knownGaps.draftStatus: Registered as draft, not active. Two things have no CLI equivalent and need the Bazantic dashboard: reviewing/setting real per-method prices (every discovered method starts at a default), and flipping status from draft to active. auth-type x402-mpp needs no credential entry, so that step is already done.
knownGaps.mcp404WhileDraft: GET /mcp on the gateway 404s right now. Per Bazantic's own docs this is expected for a draft gateway -- mcp:true in the listing is eligibility, not confirmation a server is deployed and answering. Re-check with tools/list after activation.
knownGaps.paymentSettlementStillStubbed: services/gateway's verifyPayment accepts any non-empty X-PAYMENT header. The 402 challenge itself is real (correct CAIP-2 network, real Hedera testnet USDC asset id, real payTo address); actual settlement verification against a facilitator is still the day-7 TODO in services/gateway/src/x402.ts.

deployment.config: services/gateway/wrangler.jsonc -- vars block carries X402_NETWORK, X402_ASSET, X402_BID_PRICE_USDC, X402_PAY_TO_ADDRESS
deployment.architectureNote: services/gateway/src/app.ts exports a plain Hono app with no module-scope env access -- config is resolved per-request from Hono's c.env (Workers) with a process.env fallback (Node). src/index.ts is the Workers entry (`export default app`); src/local.ts is the Node entry (@hono/node-server's serve()). Both run the identical app.
deployment.removedDependency: @x402/hedera was imported only for four constants (network id, USDC asset id, decimals, a validity check) but its barrel re-exports @hiero-ledger/sdk's full gRPC client, which needs fs/tls/node:path and cannot bundle for Workers. Those four values are now inlined locally with a note to re-verify against @x402/hedera on any version bump; nothing else changed.
